# PASCO

> PASCO provides science lab equipment, wireless sensors, and digital learning platforms for K-12 and higher education STEM instruction.

PASCO specializes in hands-on science education solutions including datalogging hardware, curriculum resources, and the PASCO Portal learning platform. The company serves physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, and environmental science educators across middle school, high school, and college levels.

## Key Topics

- Wireless Sensors
- STEM Education
- Data Collection
- Lab Equipment
- PASCO Portal
- SPARKvue
- PASCO Capstone
- Physics Experiments
- Hands-on Learning
- Sensor Technology
- Spectrometry
- AP/IB Courses
- Science Curriculum
- Teacher Resources
- Professional Development

## Core Platform & Products

- [PASCO scientific | Science Lab Equipment and Teacher Resources](https://www.pasco.com): Homepage showcasing PASCO's science lab equipment and STEM education solutions
- [Products for Science Education | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/products): Main product catalog featuring sensors, datalogging, and curriculum solutions
- [PASCO Portal | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/portal): Overview of PASCO Portal digital learning platform with curriculum and resources
- [Explore by Subject | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects): Subject directory for browsing STEM curriculum and sensor technology products

## Subject-Specific Solutions

- [High School Physics - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/highschool-physics): High school physics lab equipment including SMART Cart for AP/IB courses
- [College & University Physics - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/college-physics): College physics equipment and lab solutions including wireless sensors
- [High School Chemistry - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/highschool-chemistry): High school chemistry solutions with wireless spectrometers and NGSS alignment
- [College & University Chemistry - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/college-chemistry): College chemistry lab instrumentation including UV-Vis spectrometry equipment
- [High School Biology - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/highschool-biology): High school biology lab equipment for AP/IB with wireless sensors and data analysis
- [College & University Biology - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/college-biology): College biology lab equipment with wireless sensors and spectrometry tools
- [High School Engineering - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/highschool-engineering): High school engineering kits and equipment for STEM hands-on learning
- [College & University Engineering - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/college-engineering): College engineering products for materials testing and structures analysis
- [Environmental Science - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/highschool-earth-and-environmental): Environmental science curriculum with wireless sensors and ecosystem monitoring
- [Middle School Physical Science - Subjects | PASCO](https://www.pasco.com/subjects/physical-science): Middle school physical science curriculum with OpenSciEd partnership integration
